config-sort-order-comment: Default sorting strategy for player inventory and containers. Scroll the mouse wheel over the Sort button to cycle it live; sort hotkeys are unassigned by default in Controls.
config-sort-hotbar-with-backpack-comment: Include unlocked hotbar slots when sorting your inventory or using Store Nearby (Shift+G).
config-stack-perishables-comment: Merge perishable food stacks with different freshness by blending spoil progress (also toggleable from the inventory header).
config-skip-favorites-when-sorting-comme: Keep favorite-marked items in place during sorting (Quick Store always skips favorites).
config-section-ui: 2. Inventory UI, Badges & Item Match Highlight
config-enable-matching-highlight-comment: Highlight all visible inventory/chest slots in light brown containing the same item as the slot under your cursor or held on the mouse.
config-hide-favorites-overlay-comment: Only display gold star favorite badges while Favorite Mode is active in the inventory title bar.
config-hide-locked-slot-overlay-comment: Only display red padlock badges while Lock Slot Mode is active (locked slots are excluded from sorting, Store Nearby and Refill).
config-hide-sort-button-comment: Hide the Compact & Sort button from inventory and container title bars (shortcuts still work in Controls).
config-hide-quick-store-button-comment: Hide the Quick Store button in open container title bars.
config-hide-store-nearby-button-comment: Hide the Store Nearby button in the player inventory (default shortcut: Shift+G).
config-hide-stack-perishables-button-com: Hide the Force-stack perishables toggle button in the player inventory.
config-enable-slot-indicators-comment: Draw compact status bars on slots (top edge; liquids centered in the middle). Automatically skips tools/armor that already show vanilla's bottom durability bar.
config-slot-freshness-comment: Show remaining freshness on perishable foods and sealed/open meal containers (pulses red when spoiling soon).
config-slot-liquid-comment: Show blue liquid fill levels centered on buckets, jugs, bowls and watering cans.
config-slot-crucible-comment: Show fill level in crucibles and pulse bright orange while metal is molten.
config-slot-food-container-comment: Show remaining servings on cooking pots, meal bowls, pies and crocks.
config-slot-preparation-comment: Show drying, curing, ripening or melting progress bars.
config-slot-durability-comment: Show condition bars for clothing items (tools/weapons already showing vanilla durability are skipped).
config-slot-night-vision-comment: Show remaining temporal fuel charge on night-vision devices.
config-enable-hotbar-refill-comment: Automatically refill depleted hotbar stacks from unlocked backpack slots. Press Alt+L anytime to swap the brightest light source into/out of your offhand (rebindable in Controls).
config-refill-consumables-comment: Automatically pull matching food/consumables from backpack when a hotbar stack runs out.
config-refill-blocks-comment: Automatically pull matching building blocks from backpack when a hotbar stack runs out.
config-refill-tools-comment: Disabled by default: when enabled, swaps a hotbar tool with a fresh matching one from your backpack before it breaks.
config-tool-durability-threshold-comment: Remaining durability at which a hotbar tool is preventively replaced (when preventive tool replacement is enabled).
config-refill-delay-ms-comment: Delay in milliseconds before refilling to avoid client/server inventory desync.
config-prefer-smallest-refill-comment: Take the smallest matching stack from your backpack first to keep storage tidy.
config-section-radial-menus: 5. Radial Menus (F Tool Mode | Alt+F Quick-Swap)
config-enable-radial-tool-mode-comment: Replace the default grid tool mode menu (F key) with a circular radial wheel. Scroll the mouse wheel if there are more than 10 options.
config-tool-mode-select-release: Tool Menu: select on key release
config-tool-mode-select-release-comment: Automatically apply the hovered tool mode when releasing the F key (otherwise click Left Mouse to pick).
config-enable-quick-swap-comment: Press Alt+F (rebindable in Controls) to open a radial wheel of your tools and light sources from hotbar and backpack.
config-quick-swap-release-comment: Automatically switch to the hovered tool/light when releasing the Alt+F Quick-Swap key.
config-radial-tool-mode-radius-comment: Outer radius in pixels shared by both the Tool Mode (F) and Quick-Swap (Alt+F) radial wheels.
config-enable-alloy-calculator-comment: Automatically attaches an alloy, nugget and fuel planner panel alongside firepits containing a fired crucible, using native inventory transfers.
config-alloy-units-per-nugget-comment: Fallback metal units per nugget for waste-free steps (vanilla nuggets: 5 units, 1 ingot = 100 units).
config-alloy-search-nearby-comment: Optional: include nuggets and fuel stored in nearby chests/containers around the firepit when planning and depositing.
config-alloy-search-radius-comment: Search radius in blocks (4 to 10) around the firepit when nearby container search is enabled.
config-enable-ground-highlight-comment: Hold Sneak (Shift) to highlight dropped items around you; stays visible briefly after standing up (no hotkey required).
config-always-highlight-ground-comment: Keep nearby ground item markers visible continuously without needing to sneak.
config-show-ground-names-sneak: Show ground item names on sneak
config-show-ground-names-sneak-comment: Display item name and stack count labels over highlighted ground items while sneaking.
config-ground-highlight-radius-comment: Maximum search radius in blocks for ground item highlighting.
config-ground-highlight-duration-comment: Seconds ground item highlights remain visible after you release Sneak (0 = hide immediately).
config-enable-projectile-tracker-comment: Automatically place a temporary arrow icon on your world map where player arrows or spears land; cleared upon pickup or timeout.
config-projectile-waypoint-timeout-comme: Seconds before a projectile map marker auto-expires if not picked up (default: 300s = 5 min; 0 = never).
config-enable-resource-particles-comment: Attach subtle native particles directly onto selected exploration blocks (takes effect live without restarting).
config-highlight-resin-comment: Emit dripping golden-amber particles on unharvested pine/acacia resin logs.
config-highlight-terrapreta-comment: Emit subtle dark earthy-brown spores over Terra Preta compost soil blocks.
config-highlight-meteoric-iron-comment: Emit tall iron-ember sparks rising 4+ blocks without collision so buried meteorites are spottable from the surface.
config-enable-animal-sex-indicators-comm: Hold Sneak (Shift) to show sex, pregnancy (♂ / ♀ / ♀+) and Roman numeral generation (I, II, III...) above nearby animals.
config-animal-indicator-wild-comment: When enabled, also shows sex badges on wild animals (generation 0), not only bred livestock (generation >= 1).
config-animal-indicator-range-comment: Maximum distance in blocks from the camera to display animal status badges.
config-animal-indicator-opacity-comment: Base opacity of animal status badges before distance fade.
config-animal-indicator-scale-comment: Size multiplier for the 3D animal status badges.
config-enable-entity-health-bars-comment: Render a retro framed health bar above nearby living entities (with animal badges stacked neatly above the bar).
config-healthbar-hostiles-comment: Show health bars on temporal monsters and aggressive predators (drifters, shivers, wolves, bears, etc.).
config-healthbar-passive-fauna-comment: Show health bars on passive wild animals and domesticated livestock.
config-healthbar-traders-npcs-comment: Show health bars above traders and friendly humanoid NPCs.
config-healthbar-players-comment: Show health bars above other players in multiplayer.
config-healthbar-only-damaged-comment: Hide entity health bars while the entity is at full health.
config-healthbar-require-sneak-comment: Only show entity health bars while holding Sneak (Shift).
config-healthbar-always-show: HP Bar: Always show (not only when looking)
config-healthbar-always-show-comment: By default health bars appear only while looking at an entity (plus linger delay). Enable to show all nearby matching health bars at all times.
config-healthbar-linger-seconds-comment: Seconds an entity health bar stays visible after you look away (default: 2.5s).
config-healthbar-range-comment: Maximum distance in blocks from the camera to render entity health bars.
config-fauna-preset-comment: Quickly apply balanced wild animal HP & butchering presets, or pick Custom when tuning multipliers manually (server-side).
config-enable-fauna-rebalance-comment: Server master switch for wild animal health and harvesting drop scaling.
config-small-prey-health-comment: Health multiplier for small wildlife (hares, roosters, hens, etc.).
config-medium-large-prey-health-comment: Health multiplier for deer, pigs, sheep, goats and moose.
config-predator-health-comment: Health multiplier for wolves, bears, hyenas and foxes.
config-meat-drop-mult-comment: Multiplier for butchered raw meat and poultry drops.
config-hide-drop-mult-comment: Multiplier for harvested hides and pelts.
config-byproduct-drop-mult-comment: Multiplier for bones, feathers, horns and antlers.
config-scale-domesticated-health-comment: If enabled, domesticated livestock (generation > 0) also receives HP scaling.
config-scale-domesticated-drops-comment: If enabled, domesticated livestock receives scaled butchering drops.
config-include-aquatic-fauna-comment: Include aquatic animals in fauna rebalancing.
config-enable-inventory-management-comme: Server switch authorizing sorting, Quick Store and Store Nearby across connected players.
config-enable-store-nearby-comment: Allow players to deposit matching items into nearby whitelisted containers.
config-store-nearby-radius-comment: Maximum search radius in blocks (1-16) for Store Nearby.
config-require-land-claim-comment: Enforce Vintage Story land claim access checks before depositing into nearby containers.
config-allow-hotbar-refill-comment: Server switch allowing automatic hotbar refills and preventive tool swaps.
config-allow-projectile-tracker-comment: Server switch allowing temporary map waypoints for player-fired projectiles.
config-stack-size-preset-comment: Quickly apply a stack size profile (Vanilla, P1nksBalanced, Double2x, Builder4x), or switch to Custom when editing values manually (server-side).
config-enable-stack-size-modifier-commen: Server master switch to scale stack sizes live without restarting (automatically protects tools, armor, backpacks, liquids and populated skeps).
config-global-stack-multiplier-comment: Base multiplier combined with each stackable category multiplier.
config-building-blocks-stack-mult-commen: Stack multiplier for blocks, stone, planks, bricks, shingles, logs, soil and construction materials.
config-resources-stack-mult-comment: Stack multiplier for ores, nuggets, ingots, plates, fuel, sticks, clay, flax, leather and raw materials.
config-food-stack-mult-comment: Stack multiplier for meats, vegetables, fruits, grains, bread, seeds, saplings and healing items.
config-misc-stack-mult-comment: Stack multiplier for all other naturally stackable items.
config-allow-unstackable-containers-comm: Allow vanilla 1-stack empty containers, furniture/processing blocks and clothing to stack up to the caps below.
config-empty-containers-max-stack-commen: Max stack size for barrels, buckets, crocks, bowls, crates, chests and baskets.
config-furniture-utility-max-stack-comme: Max stack size for beds, doors, bookshelves, querns, bellows, bloomeries, maps, books and unpopulated skeps.
config-clothing-max-stack-comment: Max stack size for non-armor seraph clothing items.
config-max-stack-size-cap-comment: Upper limit applied to any modified stack size (excluding protected liquids).
